scope: Unchanged original test bodies import actual Rust Store/queue/receipt protocol through a test-only synchronous transport. Callback bodies, Promise scheduling, HealthBoard, Intl text segmentation, Runtime, SourceRegistry and model helpers remain JS controls. KV source-lint assertion is TS-only. Not production Runtime/source/migration acceptance.

declarations.title: refuses databases newer than this build and rolls back failed atomic work
finds triggers by thread
reads the working sets alone, in SQLite as in memory, and follows each save
adds the working sets to a database that predates them, from the rows it holds
names a thread by its first human trigger
counts triggers per Source and lists them newest first, optionally only the filtered ones
links a Thread to the page its Source named, or else to the message that started it
sets and removes a Source's keys in a Thread's meta
spells every kv key in KV alone, so each record is named by its entry there
runs what waits for a commit once the outermost transaction commits, and never what a rolled back one queued
reports an action that fails after a commit, runs the others, and keeps what committed
closes a database it cannot open as this version's, so a later attempt can open it
keeps the settings as versions: the current settings are the snapshot of the current revision, kept nowhere else
replaces a working-set column an earlier build defined otherwise, and drops one this version no longer has
lists in the same order in SQLite and in memory, and undoes a failed nested transaction alone in both
creates the state directory for its owner alone, and the database readable by its owner alone
reads `%` and `_` in a key prefix and a search query as written, not as patterns
runs an effect queued inside a transaction once it commits, and none from a transaction that rolled back
keeps one effect per key with the latest payload, and runs it again when a new payload arrives while it runs
runs a kind oldest first, as many at once as its limit allows, and holds it while the limit is 0
keeps an effect's place in its queue when it is queued again with a new payload
retries a failed effect after a delay that doubles up to its maximum, and reports the kind in error after three failures
starts nothing once drained, keeps what waits and what shutdown cut short, and runs it after the next start
lets a handler defer an effect without a failure, until a later dispatch after its first delay
runs an ordered kind one at a time in the order queued, and holds the later effects while an earlier one fails
keeps a quiet kind's failures out of its health, and asks no limit while nothing is due
keeps an effect cancelled and queued again while its first run goes on, which the first run does not end
queues an effect after a restart behind the ones that waited, for a kind that keeps its order
reports a failure of the queue itself under its kind, until a dispatch of that kind succeeds again
refuses a second handler for a kind
holds every message while processing is paused, and sends it once processing resumes
keeps a message for a Source that is not installed waiting, and sends it once the Source's kind registers
